description: The field inspector actions, selection actions and optional numeric geometry.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether the inspector is read-only. Geometry stays editable to read; actions disable.

parameters.name: PasteEnabled
parameters.description: Whether the clipboard has a field the Paste action can place.

parameters.name: ShowCopy
parameters.description: Whether the Copy action has a host delegate.

parameters.name: ShowDelete
parameters.description: Whether the Delete action has a host delegate.

parameters.name: ShowCopySelection
parameters.description: Whether the selection Copy action has a host delegate.

parameters.name: ShowPaste
parameters.description: Whether the selection Paste action has a host delegate.

parameters.name: ShowDeleteSelection
parameters.description: Whether the selection Delete action has a host delegate.

parameters.name: OnCopy
parameters.description: Copies the edited field.

parameters.name: OnDelete
parameters.description: Deletes the edited field.

parameters.name: OnCopySelection
parameters.description: Copies every selected field.

parameters.name: OnPaste
parameters.description: Pastes the clipboard.

parameters.name: OnDeleteSelection
parameters.description: Deletes every selected field.

parameters.name: ShowGeometry
parameters.description: Whether the pixel geometry section is shown.

parameters.name: GeometryArea
parameters.description: The area the geometry inputs edit. Null hides the section.

parameters.name: GeometryX
parameters.description: Horizontal position in pixels.

parameters.name: GeometryY
parameters.description: Vertical position in pixels.

parameters.name: GeometryWidth
parameters.description: Width in pixels.

parameters.name: GeometryHeight
parameters.description: Height in pixels.

parameters.name: OnGeometryXChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the horizontal position changes.

parameters.name: OnGeometryYChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the vertical position changes.

parameters.name: OnGeometryWidthChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the width changes.

parameters.name: OnGeometryHeightChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the height changes.

parameters.name: GeometryXAttributes
parameters.description: Attributes forwarded to the X input.

parameters.name: GeometryYAttributes
parameters.description: Attributes forwarded to the Y input.

parameters.name: GeometryWidthAttributes
parameters.description: Attributes forwarded to the width input.

parameters.name: GeometryHeightAttributes
parameters.description: Attributes forwarded to the height input.
